name: WF-PHISH-TRIAGE
description: Webhook/execute -> gemma4:12b vision phishing triage of a screenshot OR a rendered URL (browserless, SSRF-guarded) -> Discord. Endpoints injected from .env at deploy.

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json, urllib.request, base64, ipaddress, socket, urllib.parse

GEMMA = "$gemma_url/api/generate"
RENDER = "$render_url/screenshot"
MODEL = "gemma4:12b"
PROMPT = ("You are a SOC phishing analyst examining a screenshot of a web page or email. "
          "Decide whether it is a credential-phishing or brand-impersonation lure. Base the "
          "verdict ONLY on what is visible and cite concrete visual cues. Respond with ONLY this "
          "JSON: {\"brand_impersonated\":\"<brand or none>\",\"is_phishing\":<true|false>,"
          "\"confidence\":<0.0-1.0>,\"red_flags\":[\"<visible cue>\"],\"summary\":\"<one sentence>\"}")

raw = ""
if isinstance(self.full_execution, dict):
    raw = self.full_execution.get("execution_argument", "") or ""
try:
    payload = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
except Exception:
    payload = {}

source = str(payload.get("source", payload.get("reporter", "manual")))[:120]

def san(s):
    return str(s).replace('"', "'").replace("\\", "").replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ").strip()

def is_public_url(u):
    # SSRF guard: only render globally-routable http(s) hosts. is_global excludes loopback,
    # RFC1918, link-local, CGNAT/Tailscale shared space, reserved and multicast in one check.
    try:
        p = urllib.parse.urlparse(u)
        if p.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not p.hostname:
            return False
        return ipaddress.ip_address(socket.gethostbyname(p.hostname)).is_global
    except Exception:
        return False

img = payload.get("image_b64") or payload.get("image") or ""
url_in = payload.get("url") or ""
err = ""

if not img and url_in:
    if not is_public_url(url_in):
        err = "rejected non-public URL (SSRF guard): " + san(url_in)
    else:
        try:
            rb = json.dumps({"url": url_in, "options": {"type": "png", "fullPage": False}}).encode()
            rr = urllib.request.Request(RENDER, data=rb,
                                        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
            png = urllib.request.urlopen(rr, timeout=60).read()
            img = base64.b64encode(png).decode()
            if source == "manual":
                source = "url:" + url_in[:80]
        except Exception as e:
            err = "render failed: " + san(str(e))[:150]

if not img:
    print(json.dumps({"combined": "**Phishing Triage** | error: " + (err or "no image_b64 or url in payload"),
                      "is_phishing": "false", "error": "no_input"}))
else:
    body = json.dumps({"model": MODEL, "prompt": PROMPT, "images": [img], "stream": False,
                       "format": "json",
                       "options": {"num_predict": 1024, "temperature": 0, "num_ctx": 8192}}).encode()
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(GEMMA, data=body,
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180)
        out = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        rv = out.get("response", "")
        try:
            v = json.loads(rv)
        except Exception:
            i, j = rv.find("{"), rv.rfind("}")
            v = json.loads(rv[i:j + 1]) if i >= 0 and j > i else {}
        is_phish = bool(v.get("is_phishing"))
        brand = san(v.get("brand_impersonated", "unknown"))
        conf = v.get("confidence", "")
        summary = san(v.get("summary", ""))
        flags = v.get("red_flags", []) or []
        flag_txt = san("; ".join(str(f) for f in flags))[:600]
        head = "PHISHING" if is_phish else "looks clean"
        lines = ["**Phishing Triage**",
                 "Verdict: " + head + " (brand: " + brand + ", confidence: " + str(conf) + ")",
                 "Summary: " + summary,
                 "Flags: " + (flag_txt or "none"),
                 "Source: " + san(source)]
        combined = "\\n".join(lines)
        if len(combined) > 1950:
            combined = combined[:1947] + "..."
        print(json.dumps({"combined": combined, "is_phishing": str(is_phish).lower(),
                          "brand": brand, "confidence": conf}))
    except Exception as e:
        print(json.dumps({"combined": "**Phishing Triage** | model error: " + san(str(e))[:200],
                          "is_phishing": "false", "error": "model"}))
